text: hm. inside of the compiled route it is incredibly laggy, inside of the standalone, it isnt.
resolution: Investigated the reported lag difference between hmsc-int /compiled and standalone world_loader. Found that both paths use the same world_loader.zig render core, but /compiled runs inside the full hmsc-int V8/editor host frame while standalone runs as a dedicated no-V8 binary. The likely cause is route-shell overhead: hmsc-int keeps editor panes mounted under route overlays so /compiled can still pay hidden editor layout/paint/timer cost. No code change was completed because the user interrupted to clarify the router point.
